svg.text: A read must never overtake a pending write to the same block. Doing that with a flat 128-entry CAM at 1 GHz across 256 slices would cost ~30 W in search power alone.
The read never touches DRAM at all.
The property that makes this safe
False POSITIVES cost a cycle. False NEGATIVES are impossible, because the 12-bit tag is a pure function of the full 25-bit tag.
That is a property you PROVE, not a property you test - see the verification plan, P-WB-1.
